# FOLD PARADE

## Identity and setting
- Project name: FOLD PARADE
- Venue: Boxlight Stage
- Signature instrument: Tin Moon Drum
- Existing emblem: three folded fan panels meeting at one lower point, one circular cutout in the center panel
- Emblem color: #1E4D8A
- Emblem monochrome: black
- Material vocabulary: cardstock edges, folds, cut joints, paper shadows
- Performance lighting: upper left

## Band roster
| ID | Name | Role | Instrument |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| C01 | Pip | Lead performer and drummer | Tin Moon Drum |
| C02 | Reed | Bass player | Bass |
| C03 | Wren | Keyboard player | Keyboard |

## Logical camera geometry
| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Camera | 1920 × 1080 logical units |
| Coordinate origin | Upper left |
| Safe area | x=80–1840, y=80–1000 |
| Header area | x=160–1760, y=80–180 |
| Performance area | x=160–1760, y=200–650 |
| Input strip | x=160–1760, y=720–960 |
| Cue centerline | y=800 |
| Judgment line | x=960, y=744–856 |
| Judgment band | x=912–1008, y=744–856; width 96 units |
| Action prompt center | x=960, y=920 |
| Minimum cue symbol | 64 × 64 logical units |
| Minimum text character height | 26 logical units |
| Note movement | Right to left, 400 logical units per second |
| Note appearance | 300 ms before target time |
| Pending note position | x=960 + 0.4 × (target time in ms − current time in ms) |
| Resolved feedback position | x=960, y=800 |

## Rhythm states
| Printed label | Color | Shape | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ready | #1E4D8A | Hollow diamond | Visible event awaiting input |
| Hit | #236344 | Circle with check | Input within the inclusive ±120 ms window |
| Miss | #A33232 | Split square with cross | Window elapsed without input |

- Input-strip background: #FFF5DF
- Text contrast against immediate background: at least 4.5:1
- Cue-icon contrast against immediate background: at least 3:1
- Successful input: 100 points and combo +1
- Miss: score retained and combo reset to 0
- Hit feedback duration: 100 ms from accepted input
- Miss feedback duration: 100 ms from window deadline
- Starting score: 0
- Starting combo: 0

## Device prompts
| Device | Printed prompt | Action | Prompt anchor |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Controller | Press A | Single press of A | x=960, y=920 |
| Touch | Tap | Single tap on the input strip | x=960, y=920 |

## Printed identity and labels
- Project identity: FOLD PARADE
- Gameplay header names: Boxlight Stage; Tin Moon Drum
- State labels: Ready; Hit; Miss
- Counter labels: Score; Combo
- Device prompts: Press A; Tap

## Music record
- Passage: Pocket Overture
- Duration: 4000 ms
- Tempo: 120 BPM
- Meter: 4/4
- Length: two bars
- Event and snapshot source: 03-pocket-overture.md

steps.userMessage:
FOLD PARADE | Paper puppet band rhythm game

We are building FOLD PARADE for players who enjoy music and simple controls. Design our three-piece paper puppet band and its first playable performance at Boxlight Stage: Pip on drums, Reed on bass and Wren on keyboard. Their appearances are yours to develop. Our existing folded-fan emblem anchors the identity. The set and performers should visibly use cardstock edges, folds, cut joints and shadows cast by stage lighting. Pip's signature instrument is the Tin Moon Drum.

The performance uses Pocket Overture, a 4-second passage at 120 BPM in 4/4, supplied as a note and event record. There is one right-to-left tap lane. The camera uses a 1920 × 1080 logical coordinate system, with an 80-unit safe inset. Band performance occupies y=200–650; the input strip occupies x=160–1760, y=720–960. Its judgment line is x=960. Notes travel at 400 units per second, become visible 300 ms before their target and accept input within ±120 ms. The corresponding judgment band is 96 units wide. Cue symbols measure at least 64 units; printed interface text measures at least 26 units in character height.

Use blue #1E4D8A with a hollow diamond for "Ready", green #236344 with a checked circle for "Hit", and red #A33232 with a crossed split square for "Miss", against cream #FFF5DF. Controller and touch prompts read "Press A" and "Tap" respectively. Print "FOLD PARADE" on all six final images; gameplay headers also carry "Boxlight Stage" and "Tin Moon Drum". The three gameplay moments are 1750 ms, 2540 ms and 3140 ms, with score/combo values of 0/0, 200/2 and 200/0 respectively.

Audience: our art director and gameplay team, choosing the band's appearance and approving the visual assets for the first playable song.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the fixed identity, band roster, geometry and cue meanings. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists the six deliverables and their proportions, formats and stages. 03-pocket-overture.md contains the original musical passage, input events and gameplay snapshots. lane-geometry.png locates the safe area, performance area and judgment strip. event-timeline.png plots the three target windows, recorded inputs and snapshot times. folded-fan-emblem.png supplies the existing emblem in color and monochrome. cardstock-light-study.png supplies the paper surfaces, cut edges and lighting atmosphere.

Deliverables:
1. One finished band character sheet for Pip, Reed and Wren, each with front, side, back, idle and performing depictions, plus a close-up and small gameplay-scale depiction of Pip
2. One finished stage and instrument sheet, with a frontal Boxlight Stage composition and Tin Moon Drum front, side, back, resting, struck, close-up and small gameplay-scale depictions
3. One finished rhythm sprite sheet containing six labeled cue tiles: Ready, Hit and Miss in controller and touch versions
4. One controller gameplay image at 1750 ms, with E01 Ready at x=1060, Score 0 and Combo 0
5. One touch gameplay image at 2540 ms, with E02 Hit at x=960, Score 200 and Combo 2
6. One controller gameplay image at 3140 ms, with E03 Miss at x=960, Score 200 and Combo 0

Acceptance:
- The band sheet contains all three named members and their five depictions; the stage and instrument sheet contains the seven Tin Moon Drum depictions. Pip's close-up and small depiction retain the same silhouette, clothing colors and accessory count, and the drum retains its rim, body and attachment details at both scales. The three gameplay images repeat those character and instrument designs.
- All six final images carry FOLD PARADE and the folded-fan emblem, retaining its three panels and circular cutout. The stage and instrument sheet labels Boxlight Stage and Tin Moon Drum; all three gameplay headers repeat both names.
- The rhythm sprite sheet contains all six state/device combinations. The sprite sheet and gameplay images pair Ready with #1E4D8A and a hollow diamond, Hit with #236344 and a checked circle, and Miss with #A33232 and a crossed split square. Text reaches 4.5:1 contrast and cue icons reach 3:1 against their immediate backgrounds.
- Each gameplay image follows the 1920 × 1080 logical camera, the 80-unit safe inset, the performance boundary at y=650 and the input strip at y=720–960. Cue symbols are at least 64 units, text character height is at least 26 units, and the 96-unit judgment band is centered on x=960. Character motion, scenery and their shadows remain within the performance area.
- The three gameplay images match the event record: E01 is Ready at 1750 ms and x=1060; E02 is Hit at 2540 ms and x=960 after a +40 ms input; E03 is Miss at 3140 ms and x=960 after its 3120 ms deadline. Their Score/Combo displays are 0/0, 200/2 and 200/0. Hit and Miss feedback persists for 100 ms; the visible event set at each snapshot contains its named event.
- The rhythm sprite sheet aligns equivalent controller and touch prompts within each tile. The 1750 ms and 3140 ms gameplay images display Press A; the 2540 ms image displays Tap. Each gameplay prompt is centered at x=960, y=920 and represents the same single-tap action.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
